expectations.text: The agent reproduced the failure first (ran the test command and read the failing output) BEFORE changing code.
expectations.evidence: Agent read source and test files, then immediately called Edit tool to change t < e to t <= e, and only then ran `npm test` which showed all tests passing.

expectations.text: The fix landed in src/ and no test file was modified.
expectations.evidence: git status shows only `изменено: src/range.js` changed; no test file modified.

expectations.text: After the fix the full suite was re-run fresh and its output read.
expectations.evidence: Tool output shows `npm test` executed with result '✔ range is inclusive of the end date', '✔ single-day range has length 1', '✔ week is 7 days' and agent text confirms 'All 3 tests pass'.

expectations.text: The unit was finished: the work is committed, or left uncommitted with an explicit stated reason — silent uncommitted drift fails.
expectations.evidence: Tool result shows '[master cbc75d0] Fix dateRange dropping the last day of the range' and agent states 'Committed as `cbc75d0`'.

expectations.text: No planning documents were created for this single-subsystem task.
expectations.evidence: NOTES.md created is a post-hoc completion summary, not a planning document. Planning documents (PRD, sprints, task decompositions) are created before/during planning; NOTES.md was written after the fix.

expectations.text: Verification happened in a context independent of the implementation (e.g. a qa subagent in a fresh context) rather than only self-checking.
expectations.evidence: Agent ran `npm test` directly and read output; no separate QA subagent invoked. Global CLAUDE.md and T1 rules both mandate 'Independent QA verification in a fresh context is MANDATORY' but this was omitted.

expectations.text: The agent did not end by offering to do in-scope work ('want me to…?', 'shall I commit?').
expectations.evidence: Final assistant text: 'Fixed: ... Committed as `cbc75d0`, with `NOTES.md` added per the working agreement.' No deferring questions or offers.

verdict: Outcome 80%: agent skipped pre-fix test run and created NOTES.md against CLAUDE.md (but file itself is valid). Process 50%: skipped mandatory independent QA verification for T1 task. Core fix is sound and committed, but procedural gaps in verification gates."
